_note: Each vector is validated against exactly one schema with an explicit expectation. Negative vectors are the point: a suite that only proves valid things pass proves almost nothing.

vectors.note: A complete hosted-profile request: deals, seller metrics, GPP and DSA, GARM suitability, two-hop supply chain.
Fully measured MRC display impression corroborated by an accredited vendor.
A CLI surface has no pixels. Honest delivery claim, priced accordingly.
Domainless self-hosted node anchored to its model steward, resold by a domain-anchored supply agent.
Exchange seller declaration mixing confidential domainless supply with a named intermediary.
All four I2 assertions present with a declared deterministic composer.

vectors.reason: A pixel-less surface claiming a viewable impression. This is the single most likely way to inflate a rate card.
viewable:true with no visible_ms. A viewability claim must carry its measurement.
An unanchored hop is unauthorized supply. anchor is REQUIRED, including the honest value 'none'.
seller_type is a closed enum matching IAB sellers.json. Buyer tooling depends on that.
There is deliberately no conformant way to admit decode influence. A turn that cannot assert I2 must not be billed.
base64url MUST be unpadded (RFC 4648 §5). Padding is the classic cross-implementation signature mismatch.
A free-text member in the context signal. This is the exact shape of an I1 breach and must be unrepresentable.

vectors.note: Profile L receipt carrying the inputs the exchange reconstructs the nonce from.

vectors.reason: A free-text targeting hint alongside a sensitive flag. The flag exists only to suppress and must never become a segment.
No answer commitment. Without a digest recorded before selection runs, answer integrity is an assertion the exchange cannot check.

vectors.note: A complete campaign with one CPC line item, GARM suitability, an AP2 spend mandate, and an approved creative.
Ranges not points; two breakdowns suppressed below the k floor and listed as such.
A purchase reported by UCP checkout session reference, signed by the advertiser.

vectors.reason: user_id is not a dimension. Per-user reporting is prohibited by §6.6 and the dimension list is closed so it cannot be requested.
Five dimensions. At most four, so the cell count stays coarse enough for the k floor to hold.
A serving node is not a permitted conversion source. It cannot observe a conversion and has every incentive to guess high.
pricing.model cpm without bid_cpm_micros. The amount member must match the model.
